The first time the target willingly moves a cumulative 10 feet or makes an attack while Bleeding, it takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus using the selected Piercing or Slashing type and Bleeding ends after the triggering action or movement commits.

riders: Once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, you may spend 1 Demon Spine to add 2d6 Piercing or Slashing damage to that hit. The target then makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, it becomes Bleeding until the start of your next turn. This initial hit's extra damage and saving throw are worked out for you for an unarmed strike the game resolves itself. While already Bleeding, the target's first attack (even a miss) or first cumulative 10 feet of willing movement triggers delayed damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, using the selected Piercing or Slashing type; Bleeding ends after that attack or movement commits. For movement or an attack the game does not resolve itself, only this delayed Proficiency Bonus damage is applied by hand. Movement does not add another 2d6 or apply fresh Bleeding. Forced movement and teleportation do not trigger this damage. When several casters trigger Bleeding at once the delayed damage does not stack: one reminder names each source's amount and damage type.

riders: Your lineage (Kitsune, Tengu, Kappa or Jorogumo, chosen at CL3) is not on the Factory sheet: the table keeps it for the fight (the "Yokai Lineage" setting buttons, or asked the first time Unmasking needs it). Its Tell, Need, Taboo (2d10 Psychic for a knowing violation) and skill proficiency are the GM's and the sheet's.
Suppressing or revealing your Tell (Bonus Action) and using Wisdom for Deception about your nature -- not combat abilities.
Kitsune Foxfire Misdirection -- blocked: the table has no Insight contest against you and no attackable illusion, reflection or duplicate.
Tengu jump distance and fall reduction, Kappa swim Speed and held breath, Jorogumo climb Speed and ceilings -- the GM's (the table has no jumping, falling, water or climbing).

Once on each of your turns when you hit with the natural weapon or a creature fails its save against Mind Spike, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus of your lineage affinity.

riders: The Tell cannot be suppressed while Unmasking lasts -- not a combat effect. The weapon's shape (bite, claw, horn ...) is description: the table asks its damage type.
Kitsune: the step after a missed attack against your foxfire double is a free 5-foot step (no Opportunity Attack).
Worn equipment merging into the form -- the GM's.

Yokai's Bargain is negotiated: it forms only if both parties knowingly accept its stated terms, and its benefits (skill Advantage, travel speed, Temporary Hit Points at the start of the first scene it is pursued, telepathy, crossing a ward) and a Yokai Claim after a knowing breach are the GM's.

The printed Grapple/Restrain/Speed-reduction-only triggers for Pressure of Recognition (without damage or forced movement) are GM-adjudicated -- the table has no generic "applied one of these five specific effects" scan.
Resistance to Cold, swim Speed, amphibious breathing, deep-water pressure immunity and submerged Darkvision are passive build benefits, not fight actions.

Stolen Radiance also comes from a hostile creature succeeding on a save because of a blessing or activating a visibly sanctified effect the table does not see, and never from your own effects, staged blessings, harmless summons or ceremonial healing -- the GM's. Qualifying radiance at the table: a beneficial effect its own side put on the creature (a buff condition, AC, resistance, immunity, Speed), or healing / Temporary Hit Points from a technique; the GM rules out mundane recovery, armor and cover.
